title: ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible
abstract: arXiv:2609.39933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. translated_title: ConflictGuide：让竞争行为可见以改进自动研究系统
translated_abstract: 在设计机器学习模型时，理想的属性之间往往存在张力：改进一种行为可能会损害另一种行为，因此任务进展可能取决于缓解这种冲突。基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动研究（AutoResearch）系统通过迭代编辑模型代码，并依据标量的任务性能反馈来决定是否保留编辑，但在很大程度上忽略了这种权衡。我们发现，标量反馈在搜索早期支持广泛的探索，但它无法揭示编辑如何影响相互竞争的行为。在预算匹配的实验中，随着任务收益递减而引入竞争行为反馈，能够增加同时改进两种行为的提案比例，并在仅使用标量反馈陷入停滞之后仍能持续取得进展。要为给定模型获取这种反馈，需要识别其相互竞争的行为，并设计探针来测量它们。为了使竞争行为反馈具有可操作性，我们提出了ConflictGuide，其可重用的ConflictGuide-Skill结合了基于文献的……
tldr: ConflictGuide通过向基于LLM的自动研究系统提供竞争行为反馈，使编辑对相互竞争行为的影响变得可见，从而在标量反馈陷入瓶颈后仍能持续取得进展，并提高同时改进多种行为的提案比例。
en_tdlr: ConflictGuide makes competing behaviors visible to LLM-based AutoResearch systems through competing-behavior feedback, enabling sustained progress beyond scalar-only plateaus and increasing the share of proposals that improve both behaviors.
